business_problem: FedEx seeks to make peak-season shipping more reliable and efficient. The source describes potential equipment issues and network bottlenecks as operational challenges its predictive technology addresses.
solution_summary: FedEx describes several implemented AI capabilities across its shipping network. AI-powered systems from Dexterity and Berkshire Grey autonomously load and unload trailers, helping team members work more safely and efficiently. FedEx also uses predictive technology to analyze network data for potential equipment issues before they happen and to route packages around bottlenecks before they form. Its AI-enabled FedEx® Tracking+ and FedEx Returns+ extend post-purchase services: Tracking+ hosts branded real-time tracking pages on customers’ own websites, while Returns+ automates return policies and suggests personalized exchanges. The page places these tools within FedEx’s global operations, but does not identify data feeds beyond network data, model or processing platforms, storage systems, deployment topology, or connections between predictive analysis and dispatch systems.
